Experiência com automação (PowerShell / Graph API) . Conhecimento em infraestrutura de certificados (PKI) .  Diferenciais:  Experiência com Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)  e Windows 365 . Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:

Quem Somos  A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Sobre a posição  Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização. A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor. Principais Responsabilidades  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud. • Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake. • Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes. • Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento. • Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure. • Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados. • Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas. • Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias. Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções. • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis. • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados. • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua. DevOps e Qualidade • Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização. • Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps. • Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas. • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe. Requisitos Obrigatórios  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos). • Experiência prática com Snowflake. • Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures. • Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud. • Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps. • Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados. • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub. • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban). • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global. Diferenciais • Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click. • Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics. • Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas. • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial. • Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

description:

About the Company  We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities. Role Overview  This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized. Key Responsibilities  Liquidity Management  Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets. Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners. Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance. Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.  FX & Trading Operations  Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows. Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing. Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics. Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.  Counterparty & Vendor Management  Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties. Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews. Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.  Risk & Governance  Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight. Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks. Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.  Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement  Lead and develop the liquidity function. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams. Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.  Requirements  Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments. Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners. Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices. Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics. Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within regulated financial services environments. Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

Nova vaga disponível para Customer Success Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

WHO ARE WE?  We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy! CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention. Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: CloudSEK’s Product Suite:  CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones:  2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.  Job Description:  As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients. Key Responsibilities:  Account Management:  Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.  Cybersecurity Expertise:  Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.  Customer Engagement:  Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.  Revenue Generation and Retention:  Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.  Product Usage and Feedback:  Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.  Operational Excellence:  Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.  Ideal candidate:   4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.  Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.  Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.  Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts  simultaneously.  Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:  Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery  Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:   We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.  Governance & Compliance  Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards. Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.  Vendor Management  Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation. Continuous Improvement & Systems Support  Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes. Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage. Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.  General Competencies  Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs. Somos uma empresa independente e lucrativa, com tecnologia comprovada e sistemas em operação em mais de 25 cidades no Brasil, em Portugal e em Itália, em rápido crescimento. Sobre a vaga  Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem quer vender com propósito e ter um impacto positivo no mundo real, trabalhando todos os dia para ajudar cidades a se tornarem mais resilientes.  Como Executivo de Vendas na greenmetrics.ai, você será a ponte entre nossas soluções tecnológicas e as necessidades urgentes das cidades brasileiras para melhorar sua capacidade de adaptação a eventos climáticos extremos, num momento em que o El Niño se apresenta como uma ameaça ao bem-estar e segurança das nossas comunidades.  No dia a dia, você vai prospectar novas oportunidades, visitar clientes, gerir o pipeline de leads, preparar propostas e fechar contratos que contribuem diretamente para criar cidades mais resilientes.  Seu trabalho vai contribuir para apoiar autoridades de emergência a priorizar áreas de risco, monitorar níveis de água em tempo real e tomar decisões informadas durante eventos extremos que se tornam cada vez mais frequentes e severos. Suas responsabilidades  Prospectar e qualificar oportunidades no Rio Grande do Sul. Agendar e conduzir visitas presenciais a municípios, apresentando casos de uso para monitoramento hidrológico e detecção antecipada de enchentes e alagamentos. Gerenciar o pipeline no CRM, garantindo dados atualizados e previsões de receita estimada. Gerenciar leads estratégicos e elaborar propostas comerciais. Negociar condições comerciais e acompanhar processos de compras públicas. Manter relacionamento com líderes municipais e fomentar expansão de contas. Representar a empresa em eventos, reforçando credibilidade técnica e institucional.  O que procuramos  +5 anos em vendas B2B ou setor público, preferencialmente em soluções tecnológicas ou SaaS. Histórico comprovado de performance com superação de meta, condução de ciclos de venda longos, contratos de alto valor, cases documentados e referências de clientes. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, condução de reuniões executivas e apresentações técnico-comerciais. Experiência com ferramentas CRM e gestão de pipeline, métricas de funil e forecast. Negociação e gestão de stakeholders com postura colaborativa e foco em resultado. Autonomia e disciplina operacional para planejar rotas, viajar para visitas comerciais e cumprir agendas de campo com eficiência. Base na região metropolitana de Porto Alegre e disponibilidade para viajar (mandatório). Conhecimentos de engenharia, hidrologia ou tecnologia são desejáveis. Disponibilidade imediata ou no curto-prazo.  O que oferecemos  Salário fixo + comissões agressivas. Produto comprovado, de alto impacto social e ambiental e forte proposta de valor. Playbooks, ferramentas e mentoria do nosso time técnico e comercial. Ambiente hands-on, autonomia e impacto concreto e mensurável.  Como se candidatar  Sabemos que você tem uma rotina intensa e respeitamos seu tempo, então basta compartilhar seu currículo atualizado com os detalhes relevantes sobre sua formação e experiência. Inclua: sua experiência em vendas B2B ou setor público, exemplos de métodos e abordagens comerciais que você utilizou e principais resultados obtidos. Prazo de candidatura: 20/jun

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:

Sobre nós  O varejo físico responde por mais de 80% das vendas no Brasil — e nenhuma das conversas entre vendedor e cliente virava dado. A KOL resolve isso: capturamos interações no PDV via áudio e entregamos inteligência real para gestores de varejo. Produto validado, pipeline ativo, estágio inicial. Cada pessoa que entra agora está construindo o que a KOL vai se tornar. Buscamos um Senior Machine Learning Engineer  para compor o nosso Founding Team  e assumir a camada de speech e inteligência conversacional — os sistemas que transformam conversas reais em lojas físicas em transcrições, insights estruturados e sinais acionáveis para gestores. Você vai trabalhar onde a qualidade da IA determina o valor que o cliente percebe. O que você fará  –     Assumir ownership pelo pipeline de speech-to-text e análise conversacional. –     Avaliar e melhorar qualidade de transcrição em ambientes ruidosos de lojas físicas. –     Trabalhar em diarização, identificação de papéis dos interlocutores e processamento de transcrições. –     Desenhar fluxos com LLMs para extração estruturada de insights, resumos, objeções e comportamentos de venda. –     Construir datasets de avaliação, métricas de qualidade, feedback loops e versionamento de modelos e prompts. –     Fazer benchmarks de provedores de speech-to-text, diarização e LLMs. –     Trabalhar com produto e engenharia para tornar insights de IA confiáveis e acionáveis. O que buscamos  –     Forte experiência em IA aplicada, engenharia de ML, NLP, speech ou engenharia de dados. –     Forte experiência com Python. –     Experiência construindo pipelines em produção, não apenas notebooks ou experimentos. –     Experiência com LLMs, extração estruturada, versionamento de prompts e modelos, e avaliação. –     Capacidade de trabalhar com dados reais, ambíguos e ruidosos. –     Forte senso de produto em torno de qualidade, confiabilidade e confiança do usuário em sistemas de IA. Diferenciais  –     Experiência com speech-to-text, diarização, processamento de áudio ou dados conversacionais ruidosos. –     Background em conversation intelligence, sales coaching ou analytics para call center. –     Experiência com fluxos de anotação, revisão humana ou otimização de custo e latência em IA. Você pode ser a pessoa certa se...  Você já colocou um pipeline de IA em produção, viu ele falhar de formas inesperadas com dados reais e construiu os mecanismos de avaliação para entender exatamente onde e por quê. Você não considera um modelo bom porque performou bem no benchmark: só quando funciona com os dados bagunçados do mundo real. Você se importa com a confiança do usuário final no output da IA — e sabe que essa confiança é construída com métricas, feedback loop e muito trabalho de avaliação, não com hype.

Aqui, valorizamos quem aprende fazendo, quem coloca a mão na massa e tem orgulho de ver o resultado do próprio esforço ganhar forma e seguir viagem. Sabemos que nada acontece sozinho: o movimento é coletivo, construído na parceria, no cuidado e na confiança entre times. Se você gosta de desafios reais, de trabalhar com propósito e quer contribuir para um futuro mais eficiente e conectado para o Brasil, seu caminho pode começar aqui. Vem fazer parte do movimento. #VemPraRumo  Sobre a posição  O Projeto PULSE  é uma iniciativa de analytics avançado que integra dados operacionais e de planejamento para aumentar a visibilidade da operação ferroviária. A solução antecipa gargalos, melhora a previsibilidade da circulação dos trens e apoia decisões estratégicas para otimização da capacidade e desempenho da malha. Responsabilidades e atribuições  Principais responsabilidades:  Garantir a confiabilidade dos dados por meio de regras, monitoramento e métricas de qualidade. Definir regras de qualidade de dados. Implementar testes automáticos. Criar SLAs de dados. Monitorar e alertar falhas. Atuar junto aos domínios na correção de problemas.  Experiência  Sólida experiência com AWS (EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch). Experiência em mensurar métricas de qualidade. Experiência com testes de qualidade de dados.  Requisitos e qualificações  Formação:  Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharias, Finanças, Administração ou áreas correlatas.  Conhecimentos técnicos:  AWS (EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch). Governança de dados. Catálogo e metadados. Compliance e LGPD.  Informações adicionais  Modelo de Trabalho  Regime de trabalho: Híbrido (3x2) Modelo de contratação: CLT Local de trabalho: Indaiatuba Horário de trabalho: Comercial Exigências de viagem: Eventual  Pacote de Benefícios  Vale Alimentação Vale Refeição Vale Transporte Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) Bônus de Segurança Ferroviária Previdência Privada Cooperativa de Crédito Empréstimo Consignado Wellhub Plano de Saúde Plano Odontológica Instrumentação Cirúrgica Auxílio Farmácia Seguro de Vida Auxílio Funeral Programa Assistencial da gestação até o pós-parto Licença Parental Estendida Material Escolar Auxílio Creche Brinquedo de Natal Kit de Natal Programa de Assistência Psicológica, Jurídica e Financeira Clube de Vantagens e Descontos Universidade Corporativa  #VemPraRumo  Sobre a Rumo  Somos a maior operadora de logística ferroviária do Brasil, cruzamos o país de Norte a Sul, através de nossos quase 14 mil km de linhas, distância equivalente a uma viagem de São Paulo até a Austrália. Nós somos a empresa de soluções logísticas do grupo Cosan, com o propósito de movimentar o Brasil e alimentar o mundo, muito além da ferrovia e você pode fazer parte desse movimento junto dos nossos +8000 colaboradores apaixonados(as)! Nossa Cultura  Aqui na Rumo somos conectados pelo nosso jeito único de ser e de fazer, o nosso DNA. Usamos as quatro letras do nosso nome para guiar nossas atitudes no dia-a-dia:  Aqui o #RespeitoImporta!  Acreditamos que as oportunidades de trabalho e de crescimento precisam ser iguais para todas as pessoas, e sabemos que um time diverso e plural é o caminho para seguir inovando e evoluindo! Nossas vagas estão disponíveis à todas as pessoas , independentemente da sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia ou raça, idade, neurodiversidade, status de deficiência, cidadania ou qualquer outro aspecto que o torne único. #VemPraRumo  Saiba mais sobre a Rumo:   Quem somos  Somos a maior operadora privada de ferrovias de carga do país  e oferecemos uma solução logística segura, competitiva e de baixo carbono para suportar o crescimento do agronegócio brasileiro. Cruzamos o Brasil de Norte a Sul , administramos cerca de 14 mil quilômetros  de ferrovias nos estados de Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo, Mato Grosso do Sul, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Goiás e Tocantins. Nossa base de ativos é formada por 1.400 locomotivas  e 35 mil vagões . São mais de 8 mil colaboradores  em todo o Brasil. Saiba mais sobre a Rumo Logística

Empresa está contratando Analista de Implantação - SAAS (Jr) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!  Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.  Estamos presentes em +20 Países  e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!  São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo! Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções.  Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências! Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:  Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Implantação - SAAS (Jr) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:  Apoiar na criação e atualização de materiais de treinamento e documentação técnica; Atendimento a projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais; Monitoração de ambientes através do Zabbiz e Grafana; Participar de chamadas com clientes nacionais e internacionais para implantação de projetos, inicialmente com acompanhamento e evoluindo para condução conforme ganho de experiência; Participar de reuniões de treinamento e/ou alinhamento da solução com clientes, fabricantes e parceiros; Abertura de demandas técnicas para os times internos; Apoiar na instalação da solução e nas atualizações dos ambientes de homologação e produção, seguindo procedimentos definidos e com acompanhamento do time mais experiente; Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar implementação de projetos, garantindo histórico claro, comunicação adequada e cumprimento dos SLAs. Manter comunicação clara e contínua com os clientes durante o ciclo de vida do projeto, informando status, próximos passos e orientações.  Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:  Formação superior completa na área de tecnologia; Experiência na área suporte/operações em atendimento ao cliente externo - nacional ou internacional; Experiencia atuando em ambiente de trabalho na área de softwares com atividades de configuração, manutenção e treinamento de clientes; Conhecimento e/ou vivência em troubleshooting e análise de logs; Conhecimentos básicos em redes e protocolos de segurança; Conhecimentos nos sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux; Disponibilidade de atuar esporádicas vezes (uma vez a cada 30 ou 45 dias) presencialmente na sede da empresa, em Campinas/SP.  Será um grande diferencial se:  Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong; Conhecimentos básicos de Scrum; Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços; Vivência em atividades rotineiras de suporte e projetos, como acompanhamento, execução e atualização de tickets; Noções de comunicação com o cliente e acompanhamento de indicadores (ex.: SLA, FCR, tempo de resposta, entre outros); Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário; Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.  O que oferecemos?  A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios  em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer ! Contratação em regime CLT; Atuação 100% Remota; Horário flexível; Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal; Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças; 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo; Day-Off no mês do aniversário; Ajuda de Custo Home Office; Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados; WellHub (antiga Gympass); Convênio médico; Convênio odontológico; Vale Alimentação/Refeição; Vale Transporte ou estacionamento; Auxílio Creche; Seguro de Vida.  Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!  #HSTcardtechnology #orgulhodepertencer #vempraHST

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Mobile Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Mobile Engineer (React + React Native)  LATAM | Remote | EST-Aligned | International Independent Contractor Compensation:  USD $3,000–$4,000/month (based on experience) About the Company  Our client is a rapidly growing U.S.-based technology company transforming how consumers and investors access and analyze real estate data. Their platform serves over one million users and is built around a culture of rapid experimentation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making. The team operates in a highly collaborative environment with fast development cycles, lean processes, and a strong emphasis on shipping impactful features quickly. Engineers have direct influence on product direction and regularly see their work reach production. About the Role  We're seeking a Mobile Engineer with experience building both web and mobile applications using React and React Native. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating polished user experiences, working closely with product leadership, and contributing to applications used at scale. You'll collaborate with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to build, enhance, and optimize both web and mobile experiences while helping shape the technical direction of a growing platform. What You'll Do  Build and maintain modern web applications using React and Next.js. Develop and enhance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native. Deliver high-quality features across web and mobile platforms with a focus on usability, performance, and reliability. Optimize application performance, rendering, routing, and component architecture. Collaborate with designers, product stakeholders, and backend engineers to implement new functionality. Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs while ensuring efficient state management and error handling. Participate in sprint planning, standups, code reviews, and ongoing product discussions. Contribute to front-end architecture decisions and engineering best practices. Write and maintain automated tests to support long-term application stability and maintainability.  Required Qualifications  Minimum 1 year of professional experience developing web applications with React . Minimum 1 year of professional experience building mobile applications with React Native . Strong knowledge of React.js and Next.js, including routing, SSR, SSG, and performance optimization techniques. Experience developing and maintaining React Native applications for iOS and Android. Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and asynchronous programming concepts. Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI development practices. Experience working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs. Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative product environment.  Preferred Qualifications  Experience with TypeScript. Exposure to Node.js environments such as Express or NestJS. Experience working on data-intensive, analytics, marketplace, or real estate technology platforms. Familiarity with mobile performance optimization and native module integrations.  What We're Looking For  Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences. Proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of projects and outcomes. Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills. Comfortable working directly with leadership and contributing ideas. Adaptable and energized by fast-moving environments where iteration and continuous improvement are valued.  Work Details    Location:  Latin America (Remote)   Schedule:  Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST)   Employment Type:  Full-Time International Independent Contractor If you're excited about building products used by millions of users, enjoy moving quickly, and want to make a meaningful impact across both web and mobile platforms, we'd love to hear from you.

AI Marketing Designer  Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours  A letter from our client  Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they’re looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists  Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role  This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.  On the AI side:  Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side:  The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, GitHub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes  Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency  What our client is looking for  Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using GitHub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset  What they DO NOT want  Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt  Portfolio required  Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow  What it’s like working with them  They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Empresa está contratando Business Information Security Officer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.g., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All  Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws   At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.   Why Choose HCLTech?  Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. Responsabilidades  Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Tecnologia & Sistemas: Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento, logging ou observabilidade em ambientes produtivos; Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos com sistemas modernos e legados; Conhecimento em Microsoft Dynamics 365 e Power Platform (foco em troubleshooting, não desenvolvimento principal); Experiência com arquiteturas de integração (REST APIs, GraphQL, sistemas orientados a eventos); Conhecimento em aplicações mobile (iOS/Android) e sistemas operacionais como telefonia ou field service; Visão ampla de aplicações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança em sistemas distribuídos; Familiaridade com ferramentas DevOps e ambientes múltiplos (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod). We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele. Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do. Main Responsibilities  Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution. Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay. Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity. Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage. Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues. Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track. Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations. Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed. Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives. Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding. Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms. Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start. Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools.  Required Experience  Prior experience in the patent filing industry; experience as a patent filing paralegal is strongly preferred. Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings. Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms. Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting.  Skills & Competencies  -IP Knowledge & Process Orientation Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines. Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks. A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality.  -Client Focus & Communication Genuine commitment to client service — you take ownership of queries, communicate proactively, and never let a matter fall through the cracks. Professional written and verbal communication skills, including polished client-facing email correspondence and confident participation in meetings. Calm and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage urgent, time-sensitive matters without compromising accuracy or client experience.  -Organization & Problem Solving Exceptional attention to detail: you spot errors, inconsistencies, and omissions that others miss, and you act on them decisively. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent matters across varying deadlines. Confident problem-solver who identifies root causes, considers options, and implements solutions - escalating only where genuinely necessary. Ability to manage high-volume shared inboxes effectively, ensuring timely, organized, and consistent responses.  -Technical Proficiency Accurate and efficient data entry. Proficiency across multiple software platforms and case management systems; comfortable onboarding to new tools quickly. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including creating, manipulating, and interpreting reports. Team-oriented and collaborative, with a genuine commitment to supporting colleagues and shared outcomes.

Role Overview:  We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights. Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies. Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies. Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.  Desired Skills and Qualifications:  Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics. Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work. Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory. Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.  More details on required skills:  Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage: Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic  Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.  Algebra and Number Theory  Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.  Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory  Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.  Topology and Geometry  Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.  Analysis  Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.  Probability and Statistics  Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.  Applied Mathematics  Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.  Offer Details:  Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor  Evaluation Process:  Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.  After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.  Know amazing talent? About Turing  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview  In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, review and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:   You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:   English Proficiency:  Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills. Analytical Skills:  Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills:  Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking:  Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication:  Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence:  Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. Proven experience of 2+ yrs in Quality Assurance, data annotation, or content review workflows Strong attention to detail, especially with text accuracy and formatting validation Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.  Benefits:  Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects. Competitive compensation. Flexible working hours and remote work environment.  Application Process:  Shortlisted candidates will complete an assessment. Once the assessment is cleared, candidates can start.

description:

Company Description   Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale.  Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains. The Role  This is not a SaaS helpdesk role!  It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.   You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts  - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does. In practice, that means: Owning the full customer relationship  across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact Driving onboarding and implementation  as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months Analysing operational and customer data  site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them Running Quarterly Business Reviews  with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard  — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate Surfacing expansion opportunities  — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act Supporting renewal preparation  12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case  You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product. What this role requires  Fluent English:  written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;        (additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese) Demonstrated experience managing more than three  enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries.   If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts:  you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding) Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company  What will make you stand out  Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS) Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies  What you'll be measured on  Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores. Compensation  Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

description:

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.  Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).  Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.
