title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Professor de francês

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero  FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role  This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like  A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.  Key Responsibilities:  Full Stack Engineering  Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.  AWS native Architecture  Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.  Systems Integration  Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.  Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development  Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.  Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact  Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.  What We Are Looking For  8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.  Why Freight Hero  Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role  The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities  Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.  Qualifications  5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.  Required Skills  ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.  What Success Looks Like  Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Professor de inglês em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.  What It’s Like to Work at YipitData  YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.  As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.   You Are Likely To Succeed If  You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools  to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)   What We Offer:  Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package  Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Sobre o Projeto  O projeto tem como objetivo mapear, desenhar e automatizar todo o ciclo de fechamento financeiro , eliminando atividades manuais em todas as áreas de negócio envolvidas. A ideia é liberar as equipes para focarem na análise e na tomada de decisão , enquanto o sistema assume todo o trabalho operacional . Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com os stakeholders internos, que será responsável por construir e integrar as capacidades de IA  na solução. O projeto será entregue em fases , e um dos primeiros marcos importantes é preparar e apresentar o estudo e o escopo da Fase 1  ao comitê interno de projeto. Principais Responsabilidades  Atuar como interface primária  entre as áreas de negócio (Contabilidade, Fiscal, Tesouraria, Jurídico etc.) e os times de TI/desenvolvimento. Traduzir a linguagem e as necessidades de negócio  em requisitos técnicos claros , especificações funcionais e desenhos de solução. Liderar workshops de levantamento de requisitos , mapeamento de processos e documentação de todo o ciclo de fechamento. Desenhar e propor melhorias de processo e oportunidades de automação , alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto. Colaborar com desenvolvedores e arquitetos em integrações, desenho de solução e especificações técnicas  para desenvolvimento. Trabalhar em estreita parceria com o time interno de IA  para identificar casos de uso e garantir que os recursos de IA sejam corretamente integrados ao sistema. Apoiar a definição das fases do projeto , incluindo escopo, prioridades e dependências para a Fase 1 e seguintes. Preparar e apresentar estudos, documentos de escopo e atualizações de progresso  ao comitê interno de projeto e principais stakeholders. Garantir o alinhamento entre requisitos de negócio, restrições legais/compliance e viabilidade técnica .  Perfil & Requisitos  Experiência em nível sênior  (7+ anos) em funções como Consultor Funcional, Business Analyst, Product Owner ou Solution Consultant  em projetos de Finanças/ERP/Fechamento. Capacidade comprovada de fazer a ponte entre linguagem de negócio e linguagem técnica , atuando com conforto tanto com stakeholders de finanças quanto com times de TI/desenvolvimento. Sólida compreensão de processos financeiros , idealmente incluindo contabilidade e fechamento financeiro ; exposição a processos fiscais, de tesouraria ou jurídicos será um diferencial. Experiência em projetos de implementação de sistemas , incluindo integrações, desenho de solução e elaboração de especificações funcionais/técnicas . Experiência consistente com mapeamento de processos, levantamento de requisitos e documentação  (AS‑IS / TO‑BE). Familiaridade com soluções de automação e workflow ; experiência com projetos de IA/analytics será considerada um plus. Fortes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de liderar workshops  e apresentar a comitês de direção . Conforto em atuar em projetos de longo prazo, entregues em fases , com mentalidade estruturada e orientada a resultados. Inglês avançado  (oral e escrito); outros idiomas serão um diferencial.   A Amaris Consulting se orgulha de ser um local de trabalho com igualdade de oportunidades. Estamos comprometidos em promover a diversidade dentro da força de trabalho e criar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo. Para este fim, acolhemos candidaturas de todos os candidatos qualificados independentemente do sexo, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, crenças, idade, estado civil, deficiência ou outras características.

Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios:  ● Experiência prática com CRO, Experimentação, otimização de conversão ou performance digital em empresa, agência ou consultoria. ● Experiência com testes A/B, personalização e ferramentas de experimentação. ● Boa base em copywriting aplicado à conversão. ● Conhecimento em UX, com visão crítica sobre interfaces, jornadas, fluxos e experiência do usuário. ● Familiaridade com ferramentas de analytics, métricas, dashboards, funis e leitura de dados. ● Familiaridade com ferramentas de mapas de calor, gravações de sessão e análise de comportamento do usuário. ● Capacidade de olhar para resultados de negócio, e não apenas melhorias genéricas de experiência. ● Uso recorrente de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia de trabalho. ● Vivência prática com Figma. ● Boa comunicação verbal para conduzir reuniões, apresentar análises e interagir com diferentes perfis e stakeholders. ● Organização, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade para atuar bem em um contexto 100% remoto. ● Perfil investigativo, analítico e com vontade real de crescer em CRO e Experimentação. Diferenciais desejáveis:  ● Conhecimento em acessibilidade web, HTML semântico e hierarquia de páginas. ● Repertório em análise de funis, proposta de valor e argumentação de conversão. ● Interesse constante por tendências de CRO, UX, Growth e Inteligência Artificial. ● Experiência atuando simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes. A contratação será para atuação em regime remoto, com possibilidade de deslocamentos pontuais à sede ao longo do ano, conforme necessidade. A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.   Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.   Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.   Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.   REQUISITOS  Formação Acadêmica:  Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.  Certificações:  Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE  (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Project Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Project Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Contract Type:  Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:  6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role  We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn  to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities  Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact  Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight  Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement  Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance  Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation  Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.  Required Qualifications & Experience  Technical & Operational Expertise  Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.  Revenue & Churn Acumen  Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.  Leadership & Stakeholder Management  Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.   Why This Role Matters  Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels.  We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive.  Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.  If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview   As the Team Lead for Portuguese Sketches, you oversee the end-to-end production workflow, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery of localized content. You lead a cross-functional team and ensure alignment between English and Portuguese Sketches while maintaining strict audio, visual, and subtitle quality standards. In addition to overseeing production workflow, this role functions as a key operational stabilizer within the Portuguese content ecosystem. The Team lead ensures asset readiness, prevents production bottlenecks, bridges cross-time-zone collaboration, and safeguards content integrity across localized adaptations, enabling consistent and reliable execution at scale. Key Responsibilities   Leadership & Workflow Management  Team Leadership & Workflow Management:  Assign daily tasks, prioritize deliverables, and ensure smooth coordination across Video Editors and QC Specialists.  Production Continuity Ownership:  Ensure editors are never blocked due to missing assets, incomplete folders, or lack of resource preparation. Proactively prepare videos, audios, scripts, and subtitles before daily production begins.  Cross-Team Asset Coordination:  Act as liaison between Spanish/Portugeuse production, US content teams, and India stakeholders to request, follow up, and secure required assets in a timely manner.  Process Standardization:  Develop and maintain internal documentation (SOPs, transition guides, tracking frameworks) to support workflow clarity, team alignment, and smooth leadership transitions.  Reporting, Assets & Documentation  Reporting & Performance Tracking:  Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.  Asset & Process Management:  Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.  Repository & Documentation Management : Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.  Quality & Content Oversight  Quality Oversight:  Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles; consistent visual style; complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX); and no unintended logos or asset errors. English–Portuguese Alignment:  Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content. Content Integrity Assurance:  Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.  Operations & Issue Resolution  Technical Issue Resolution:  Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.  Daily Operational Troubleshooting:  Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.  Reporting, Assets & Documentation  Reporting & Performance Tracking:  Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.  Asset & Process Management:  Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.  Repository & Documentation Management:  Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.  Operations & Issue Resolution  Technical Issue Resolution:  Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges. Daily Operational Troubleshooting:  Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards. Risk Prevention & Escalation:  Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output. Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices. Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics. Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within regulated financial services environments. Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Business Information Security Officer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.g., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All  Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws   At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades  Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema.  Requisitos e Qualificações  Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.  Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):  Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas.
